NDT software in Pascagoula: naval shipbuilding, refining and LNG on the Mississippi coast

Pascagoula is a shipbuilding town first. Ingalls Shipbuilding, part of HII, builds destroyers, amphibious assault ships and Coast Guard cutters on the Pascagoula River, and Bollinger Mississippi Shipbuilding, the former VT Halter Marine yard, builds government and commercial vessels nearby. The Navy's Supervisor of Shipbuilding for the Gulf Coast is based here. Alongside the yards sits the Chevron Pascagoula refinery, one of the larger refineries in the country, and Kinder Morgan's Gulf LNG terminal. Mississippi Power's Plant Daniel is just north near Escatawpa, and the Jackson County port and fabrication shops in Moss Point and Gautier add steady work.

That makes the Pascagoula NDT contractor distinctive. Naval shipbuilding work follows Navy technical requirements, including NAVSEA T9074-AS-GIB-010/271 for NDT and MIL-STD-2035 acceptance criteria, with heavy documentation and personnel qualification demands. Refinery and LNG work follows plant owner specifications and ASME and API codes. Many local technicians move between the two, and the companies that employ them tend to be small or mid-sized, with a lot of RT, UT, MT, PT and VT on welds.

The Atlantis ERP solution is set up for contractors who need that level of traceability. Here is how each app applies to NDT and inspection work in Pascagoula.

ERP for NDT companies in Pascagoula

An ERP for NDT companies in Pascagoula should give shipyard-level traceability: every weld report linked to a qualified technician, a calibrated instrument, a controlled procedure and a drawing, with approvals recorded. The Atlantis ERP brings certificates, equipment, dispatch, reports, procedures, quotes and invoices into one system configured to your company.

For a contractor supporting shipbuilding, the burden is documentation. A missing vision test or an instrument whose calibration lapsed mid-job can put a batch of weld inspections in question. With the Atlantis ERP, Certificates, Asset Management, Procedures, NDT Reports and Team Assignments check each other, so problems are flagged before a report is signed rather than after.

Technician certification tracking software for Pascagoula shipyard and refinery work

Technician certification tracking in Pascagoula must handle Navy-specified qualifications alongside SNT-TC-1A written practice certifications, often for the same person. The Atlantis ERP records schemes including SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other, so a NAVSEA-based qualification can be recorded under other with level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates and attachments.

Status is computed as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required and minimum OJT and training hours, so the rules for Navy work and for your industrial written practice are kept separate. Examination sheets record general, specific and practical scores against a passing score.

Vision tests are tracked individually with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception and contrast, examiner, clinic, file and expiry. The NDT profile carries radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, relevant for RT crews licensed through the Mississippi State Department of Health radiological health programme. Warning tasks appear 90 days before cert or vision-test expiry, email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when hours are logged against an invalid certificate.

NDT reporting software for weld inspection in Pascagoula

NDT reporting software in Pascagoula needs to handle a high volume of weld reports with complete traceability to drawings, WPS and procedures. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types, including RT, UT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, UT thickness, computed radiography, hardness and PMI, each with its own numbering sequence.

Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation. RT reports capture source, technique, IQI type and placement; MT reports record technique and particle type; PT reports record method and developer; UT reports include the probe calibration table. Each report records work order, request, contract, drawing, WPS, procedure and standard references and an overall result of acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. Acceptance criteria such as MIL-STD-2035 or ASME references are entered as the applicable standard on the procedure and report.

The workflow runs draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector field. Marine mode adds a vessel cover page and merges the class-society certificate, the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into the PDF, which is useful for commercial vessels classed with ABS and others. Technicians in hull blocks and tanks with no signal use the offline field app and sync later.

Procedure control for Navy and industrial work

Procedure control in Pascagoula is under more scrutiny than in most towns, because shipbuilding customers review NDT procedures before work and audit them afterwards. The Atlantis ERP procedure register holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard, acceptance criteria and text or file, with draft, submitted, reviewed, approved, published, rejected and archived states.

Approved revisions are locked. Each revision is saved as a snapshot with prepared, reviewed and approved by and dates, and rejections record a reason. Approvers receive email notifications and reminders. The AI-assisted first draft can start a new procedure from a built-in template, but a Level III reviews and approves it. Reports reference the procedure number and revision, so a reviewer can see exactly which version governed a weld inspection months later.

Calibration management software for Pascagoula NDT equipment

Calibration management software for Pascagoula NDT companies should make it impossible to lose track of an instrument's status across a shipyard, a refinery and a fabrication shop. The Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument, probe and accessory by serial number, with calibration frequency, calibration records and a certificate register, and warns when out-of-calibration equipment is assigned to a job.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited lab flag, result and next due date; the certificate register adds lab accreditation number, PDF and valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. The Purchase app records calibration labs as vendors with accreditation number and expiry, and order lines can link to a specific serial.

Equipment issue and return runs through supervisor and manager approval with condition noted, and reservations prevent clashes. The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacements. Consumables, including MT particles, penetrant, developer, couplant and PPE, have reorder levels and low-stock flags. In a humid, salty coastal environment, the maintenance and condition history is worth having.

Crew dispatch software for Pascagoula and Jackson County

Crew dispatch software in Pascagoula should stop the same qualified RT technician or radiography source-capable truck being assigned to a shipyard night shift and a refinery job at once. The Atlantis ERP blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers and moves each job from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed.

Assignments hold site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, with overlaps blocked and Time Off feeding it. Managers see technician status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date in calendar, kanban and list views. The Fleet app records which vehicles may carry radioactive sources, with transport licence number and expiry, and assignments by project and driver with mileage. The Project app holds safety induction and work permit fields for yard and plant access requirements.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Pascagoula contractors

NDT quoting and invoicing software in Pascagoula should support long-running shipyard support contracts as well as short refinery call-outs. The Atlantis ERP quotations include job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products by method and category, a branded PDF and online acceptance.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup hours with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag and rate multiplier, and are approved before billing. Invoices show project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals and lines by cost centre, method, technician, equipment serial, rate type and days or hours. Cost centres help separate shipyard and refinery work. Expenses and per diems are re-billable. The financial dashboard gives revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across 12 months.

Inspection management software for refinery, LNG and power work around Pascagoula

Inspection management software for Pascagoula plant work has to keep up with a different rhythm from the shipyards: routine inspection most of the year, then refinery turnarounds and outage windows at the power station when everything happens at once. The Atlantis ERP handles both rhythms from the same technician, equipment and job records.

Refinery and terminal work tends to bring in methods the shipyard work does not, such as IRIS and ECT on exchanger tubes, MFL on tank floors, PMI and hardness on alloy piping, and holiday testing on coatings. Each has its own report type in the ERP, and MFL reports carry scan mode and item lines. The Project app holds the client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, and safety induction and work permit fields, which matter at plant gates with their own orientation requirements. Tasks inside a project record method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, and procedure and WPS references.

Because the same technicians often move from a shipyard contract to a refinery outage, the availability calendar and double-booking checks become more useful during turnaround season than at any other time. A supervisor can see who is committed to the yard, who is free for the outage, and which instruments are due for calibration before the job starts. When a plant client asks for inspection results on a 3D model of a unit or tank, Atlantis Digital Twins can show indications and thickness trends visually.

Implementation for NDT companies in Pascagoula

Implementation begins with your quality manual and your customers' requirements. We load technicians, certifications under every scheme you use, vision tests, instruments and calibration history, procedures and revisions, customers and sites, and set up report templates for shipyard and plant clients. Anything not built in is configured during implementation.

If a prime contractor, owner or your accounting system needs data, the open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Atlantis NDT sets up and supports the ERP directly; the founder is an ASNT NDT Level III. Ask about an implementation plan for Pascagoula.

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Pascagoula is one that gives a small contractor shipyard-grade traceability without an enterprise-sized project. The Atlantis ERP is scoped to your company and priced by quote on request.

Frequently asked questions

For contractors serving shipyards and refineries, the best fit links qualified technicians, calibrated instruments, controlled procedures and weld reports. The Atlantis ERP does this and is configured per company.

Yes. Navy-specified qualifications can be recorded under the other scheme with level, method, dates, vision tests and attachments, alongside SNT-TC-1A certifications.

Yes. The applicable standard and acceptance criteria are recorded on the procedure and referenced on the report.
